llm.summary: This skill is a simple paid API integration for cosmetic ingredient compliance checks, with its external request and payment flow disclosed.

dimensions.detail: External network use and payment signature handling are expected for a paid API check, but users should recognize that cosmetic formulas or ingredient lists may be business-sensitive.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a Markdown skill file with metadata only; no executable installer, dependency, script, or bundled code is present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are limited to when to use the skill, the HTTP method, endpoint, authentication options, body schema, and expected responses; no agent override or unrelated instruction is present.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background process, privilege escalation, local file access, credential-store access, or tool modification is described.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is EU cosmetic formulation compliance checking, and the artifact only instructs posting ingredient, market, and payment-hash data to a compliance-check endpoint.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, confirm you are comfortable sending formulation ingredients and a payment transaction signature to the listed external endpoint, and treat the result as a compliance aid rather than a substitute for qualified regulatory review.
